events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for the new Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ sample, refreshments and croissants, scratch-off giveaway; the first 100 guests receive a deluxe-size sample. Offers are while supplies last.
events.caveats: The organizer-published Eventbrite listing confirms Thursday, September 17, 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle and free giveaways. Promotional items are while supplies last and photo/video content will be captured onsite. A free Eventbrite listing exists; use the direct organizer listing for current ticket/RSVP availability rather than assuming walk-in status from secondary coverage.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 12–6 PM. Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets. First 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample; other samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan — Apothékary × SUKOSHI
events.what_it_is: A three-day Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI centered on Japanese wellness traditions, with tincture sampling, tongue readings, ingredient education and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture; tincture samples and kakigori are offered, with kakigori while supplies last. A separate gift with purchase requires a purchase.
events.caveats: Current event sources agree on Sept. 18–20 at 1542 3rd Ave, with Friday 1–9 PM and Saturday/Sunday 9 AM–9 PM. Average Socialite currently presents a free RSVP action; the exact direct Eventbrite URL was not exposed in the retrieved source, so no RSVP URL is invented here. The first-50 mini tincture and kakigori are supply-limited; the 20% discount and gift-with-purchase are retail offers, not conditions of attendance.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18: 1–9 PM. Saturday Sept. 19 and Sunday Sept. 20: 9 AM–9 PM. First 50 guests each day get a mini tincture; arrive early for that giveaway and for kakigori while supplies last.

events.event_name: Yepoda — The Dewy Day Tour at Sephora Meatpacking
events.address: Sephora Meatpacking, 21-27 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty tour stop outside Sephora Meatpacking, with product try-ons, free gifts, prize opportunities and purchase-based gift-with-purchase offers.
events.what_is_free: Free gifts while supplies last and chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the non-purchase freebies; separate GWP tiers require $40+ or $60+ Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: The organizer-published Eventbrite page confirms Saturday, September 19, 12–6 PM at Sephora Meatpacking, free attendance and no-purchase freebies. Gifts are while supplies last. The retrieved Eventbrite page is the direct actionable registration source.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19, 12–6 PM, at Sephora Meatpacking. The activation is described as on 13th Street in front of Sephora; venue address is 21-27 9th Ave. Free gifts are supply-limited.

events.what_it_is: A two-day reopening celebration for Credo Beauty's SoHo store, with no-purchase gifts for early visitors, product raffles and a separate event-only gift with purchase.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary; onsite product raffles also require no purchase. A separate gift with purchase requires a $100+ in-store purchase.
events.caveats: Credo's current store locator confirms the SoHo store at 9 Prince St. Current event sources agree on Sept. 19–20 and the first-150 no-purchase gift. Average Socialite states RSVP is optional, does not guarantee gift eligibility, and gifts are first-come/first-served while supplies last. Treat access as first-come with optional RSVP rather than a guaranteed RSVP event.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19: 11 AM–7 PM. Sunday Sept. 20: 11 AM–6 PM. The first 150 guests each day receive the no-purchase gift; RSVP does not reserve one.

events.address: Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public launch pop-up for LONDONTOWN and Magnolia Bakery's dessert-inspired nail lakur collaboration.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 customers in line receive a free banana pudding dessert and a LONDONTOWN lakur product.
events.caveats: Current NYC event sources agree on Saturday, September 19, 11 AM–1 PM at Magnolia Bakery's 401 Bleecker St location and open-public access. The collaboration itself is corroborated by a current launch press release. The free pudding and lakur are limited to the first 100 people in line; no RSVP requirement was published in the verified event sources.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 19, 11 AM–1 PM at Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker St. Arrive before 11 if the first-100 pudding + lakur giveaway is the priority.
